summary: Senior Manager, Model Risk Governance candidate with ~7 years across model risk management, model validation, and risk analytics at Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. Holds delegated sign-off authority on analytical outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios under a formal MRM framework with documentation standards and escalation protocols aligned with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations. Practiced in policy and control documentation, exception identification and escalation, executive risk reporting, and model-output auditability. CFA charterholder, dual MSc; advanced Python and SQL; Excel/VBA and Power BI.
core_skills: Model Risk Management framework, policy & standards documentation
Model validation, performance monitoring, exception tracking & issue escalation
Independent model review, challenge & delegated sign-off
Stakeholder management across Risk, Finance & Audit functions

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Model Governance, Sign-Off & Independent Review
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative book).

Operates within a formal model risk management framework — independently reviews curve construction, spread calibration, cross-asset assumptions, and economic defensibility prior to production release, consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 documentation expectations.

Escalates outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with Heads of Risk and senior investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Model Validation, Controls & Performance Monitoring
bullets: Authors and maintains model documentation capturing behavioral assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays — ensuring traceability and alignment with internal control and audit-readiness standards.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation checks, and version control — strengthening the governance audit trail for model outputs.

Conducts model validation of derivatives pricing outputs (rates, FX, inflation) and cross-checks sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates; captures exceptions and tracks through to remediation, consistent with model performance monitoring and issue management processes.

sections.heading: Regulatory Reporting, Automation & Executive Communication
bullets: Prepares analytical summaries and executive-level presentations for senior stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities — translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready narratives.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and documentation — reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — covering model configuration, assumption embedding, and output validation across scope.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated client investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner requests; supported model configuration scoping and post-deployment output attestation across all assigned accounts.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — contributed to governance documentation, control design, and regulatory readiness processes.
Coordinated across actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on milestone delivery, ensuring cross-functional alignment on governance and reporting standards.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators and ALM models for Canadian and international pension-fund clients; supported model documentation that informed client-side governance and model validation processes.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization (VaR, CVaR) with risk decomposition and attribution using Ortec's GLASS platform; presented findings to investment committees.

Led onboarding and ALM modelling for a three-plan university pension merger — co-developed and validated the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics, evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
